grammarPoints.title: Unit 1 一般过去时 Past Simple
grammarPoints.rule: 动词变成过去式：climb→climbed, visit→visited；否定用 didn't + 动词原形；疑问用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形?；不规则动词：go→went, see→saw, eat→ate, take→took
examples: I climbed the Great Wall last weekend.
Did you climb the Great Wall? — Yes, I did.

grammarPoints.title: Unit 2 一般过去时疑问句 Did you...?
grammarPoints.rule: Did + 主语 + 动词原形?；肯定答：Yes, 主语 + did.；否定答：No, 主语 + didn't.；助动词 did 后动词必须用原形
examples: Did you eat mooncakes? — Yes, we did.
Did you take a trip? — No, we didn't.

grammarPoints.title: Unit 3 should / shouldn't & be going to
grammarPoints.rule: should 表示建议「应该」；shouldn't = should not；be going to + 动词原形 = 打算；描述症状用一般现在时
examples: I am going to see a doctor.

grammarPoints.title: Unit 4 be going to & want/need to do
grammarPoints.rule: be going to + 动词原形 = 打算；want to do = 想要做；need to do = 需要做；use...to... 表示用途
examples: How are you going to spend it?
I am going to buy a schoolbag.
I want to buy some books.

grammarPoints.title: Unit 5 There be & can / can't & 一般过去时
grammarPoints.rule: There is + 单数 / There are + 复数；can + 动词原形 表示能力；一般过去时：send→sent, use→used；Did you see...? — Yes, I did.

grammarPoints.title: Unit 6 Where does...come from? & should
grammarPoints.rule: Where does + 单数主语 + come from?；答：It comes from...；should 后接动词原形；3R = Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
